EncodedExponentControl.machine_result : ∀ (xs ys : List Bool) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  EncodedExponentControl.run (EncodedExponentControl.totalTime xs ys r) (EncodedExponentControl.initial xs ys r) =
      EncodedExponentControl.final xs ys r ∧
    EncodedExponentControl.Halted (EncodedExponentControl.final xs ys r) ∧

        ¬EncodedExponentControl.Halted (EncodedExponentControl.run k (EncodedExponentControl.initial xs ys r))
EncodedExponentControl.magnitude_order : ∀ (xs ys : List Bool) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  if EncodedExponentControl.reverseFlag xs ys r = true then
    SequentialBitAddition.decode xs < SequentialBitAddition.decode ys ∧
      ↑(EncodedExponentControl.magnitude xs ys r) = SequentialBitAddition.decode ys - SequentialBitAddition.decode xs
  else
    SequentialBitAddition.decode ys ≤ SequentialBitAddition.decode xs ∧
      ↑(EncodedExponentControl.magnitude xs ys r) = SequentialBitAddition.decode xs - SequentialBitAddition.decode ys

EncodedDyadicAddition.denominator_alignment : ∀ (xp yp : List Bool) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers) (zx zy : ℤ),
  let px := CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value xp;
  let py := CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp;
  let q := CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp yp r);
  CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
      {
        numerator :=
          2 ^ EncodedDyadicAddition.leftShift xp yp r * zx + 2 ^ EncodedDyadicAddition.rightShift xp yp r * zy,
        fractionalBits := q } =
    ↑zx / 2 ^ px + ↑zy / 2 ^ py

acceptance_note: Exact source-bound acceptance. One unnecessarySeqFocus style warning in EncodedDyadicAddition is retained verbatim; the two other roots are diagnostic-free. All original failures and repairs are preserved separately.
limits: Four physically encoded marked input words, independent blank work tapes, sign fields and finite register entrances are supplied. Initial encoding/allocation is not executed by this packet.
Exponent difference is computed and converted to unary by actual transitions; its cost depends on the numeric gap, not solely encoded bit length.
The common exponent is a view of an unchanged original input word. Fresh result-field construction, packed-store writeback and caller routing are outside this unit.

Exact first halt and all-prefix represented-cell bounds concern this finite eleven-tape controller; no shared root-uniform C(n+w), selected global precision, or full multiplication theorem is supplied.

The newer FixedGridReference direction proves unbounded integer fixed-Q simulation and HALVE parity. This variable-exponent controller does not implement its physical right shifts, encoding or uniform costs for free.
